full_prompt_en: A square aerial photograph looks almost straight down on a dense patchwork of cultivated fields. Irregular plots of many sizes interlock across the entire frame, with no horizon and no visible sky. Some are saturated emerald green, others muted sage, yellow-green, rust brown, or pale straw, and many show fine parallel crop rows or subtle bands of differing growth. Dark, heavily wooded strips thread between the parcels like branching seams. A narrow pale path snakes from the upper center through the middle toward the bottom, connecting small clusters of pale roofs and tiny structures placed near junctions. Several short side tracks meet it and disappear into the foliage. The field boundaries curve organically rather than forming a rigid urban grid; narrow hedges, shrubs, and occasional trees make the shapes legible. The top-down perspective compresses depth so the terrain reads simultaneously as real countryside and an intricate mosaic. Tiny bright roofs and road marks provide scale without becoming the main subject. The light is even and slightly warm, with modest shadows tucked under the trees and along a few field edges. Textures are crisp enough to distinguish planted stripes, uneven vegetation, and dense canopy, but not so sharp that the image loses its broad color pattern. A thin pale border around the chosen image appears as part of the registered reference, yet the central visual remains the aerial landscape. The composition feels observational and quietly geometric, finding abstract order in the land's irregular divisions. No map labels, compass graphic, or typography appear over the photograph.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形航拍照片几乎垂直俯看密集拼布般的耕地。大小不一的不规则田块在画面中相互嵌合，没有地平线和天空。有些是饱和翡翠绿，有些是低调鼠尾草绿、黄绿、锈棕或浅稻草色，许多田块能看见细密平行的作物行或不同生长带。深色浓密林带像分叉缝线般穿过地块之间。一条浅色窄路从上方中央蜿蜒穿过中部延向底部，连接在交叉点附近的几簇浅色屋顶和微小建筑。几条短岔路与之相接后消失在树丛里。田界有机弯曲，而非僵硬城市网格；窄篱、灌木和零星树木使形状清楚。正俯视角压缩纵深，让土地同时像真实乡村与繁复马赛克。细小亮屋顶和道路标记提供尺度，却不成为主体。光线均匀略暖，树下及部分田边藏着适度阴影。纹理清晰到能区分种植条纹、不均植被和浓密树冠，却不锐到破坏整体色块。一道细浅色边框属于参考选图，但中心视觉仍是航拍地景。构图观察性强，安静而有几何秩序，在土地的不规则分割中发现抽象结构。照片上没有地图标签、罗盘图案或排版文字。
style_prompt_en: Use a near-vertical aerial photographic viewpoint that compresses depth into a richly patterned surface. Fill the frame edge to edge with interlocking irregular shapes, fine parallel textures, branching dark seams, and a few thin pale routes. Balance emerald, sage, olive, straw yellow, and muted earth tones, allowing small light marks to establish scale. Keep the light broad and even so color relationships and boundary lines remain clear, with only modest shadows under dense textures. Preserve realistic microdetail while giving the whole arrangement the visual coherence of a mosaic. The composition has no horizon or conventional foreground; its structure emerges from repetition, variation, and winding connections across the field.
style_prompt_zh: 采用近乎垂直的航拍摄影视点，将纵深压缩为纹样丰富的表面。让相互嵌合的不规则形、细密平行纹理、分叉深色缝隙与少量浅色细路线铺满画面。平衡翡翠绿、鼠尾草绿、橄榄绿、稻草黄和低调土色，并用细小亮点建立尺度。光线宽而均匀，使色彩关系与边界线清楚，仅在密集纹理下保留适度阴影。保留真实微细节，同时令整体排列具有马赛克般的视觉统一。构图没有地平线或常规前景，其结构从重复、变化及贯穿画面的蜿蜒连接中浮现。
theme_en: A bird's-eye map of patchwork farmland divided by winding wooded paths
theme_zh: 俯瞰被弯曲林带和小路分隔的拼布农田
name: Aerial photography
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
